The class is decorated with TypeORM's @Entity(), and the id field is decorated with @Column(). These decorators define how the class maps to database tables and columns, which is ORM work that belongs in the persistence (infrastructure) layer. This is a misplaced responsibility, not just an import-direction issue: the decorators are statements inside the domain model that add database schema mapping to it.
